data_description.base_url: The address of your HomeGuide container, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8480
data_description.num_results: How many excerpts each search hands the agent. Each excerpt is up to 800 characters; keep it low for small models.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that URL. Check the address and that the HomeGuide container is running.
error.not_homeguide: The URL answered, but not like a HomeGuide instance.

abort.already_configured: HomeGuide is already configured. Edit the existing entry instead.
